issuer.name: European Commission, following a multi-stakeholder process with independent experts

relevance.reason: A voluntary code designed to help providers of general-purpose AI models demonstrate compliance with the EU AI Act's obligations on transparency, copyright, safety and security. It is implementation material for a supranational regulation, not an international treaty.
ai_provisions: Chapter on Safety and Security (for models with systemic risk)
relevance.excluded_scope: Voluntary EU implementation tool; does not create obligations independent of the AI Act and does not bind non-EU actors as such.

dates.notes: Final version received and published on 10 July 2025; approved as adequate by the Commission and the AI Board on 1 August 2025.

status_note: Voluntary code; providers may sign it to demonstrate compliance with Articles 53 and 55 of the AI Act.

languages.note: English version published; no treaty-style authentic-language clause.

sources.note: Official page: published 10 July 2025; voluntary tool; three chapters; adequacy confirmation.
Press release: final version received 10 July 2025; three chapters; relation to AI Act rules applicable from 2 August 2025.
